scientific_intent: Improve label-free clustering accuracy on independent development data by removing unsupported spatial edges, coordinating conflicting objectives during training, and adding lightweight cross-modal alignment.

global_invariants.base_architecture: Night-5 B01/C04: shrink_to_uniform rho=0.25, Corr2 disabled, IGE enabled

graph_support.A_spatial: Existing binary undirected spatial adjacency without self-loops before normalization.
graph_support.A_rna: Binary undirected RNA feature-kNN adjacency, using the existing globally fixed k and deterministic tie-breaking.
graph_support.M_shared: Elementwise logical intersection of A_spatial and A_rna.
graph_support.soft_prune: W = A_spatial * (epsilon + (1-epsilon) * M_shared); then add the same self-loop convention as N00 and apply the same symmetric normalization as N00.
graph_support.hard_prune: W = M_shared. For each zero-degree node only, add its shortest-distance original spatial edge; break distance ties by lexical barcode; symmetrize; then use N00 self-loop and normalization.
audit_outputs: edge counts before and after pruning

gradient_coordination.ige: Use N00 IGE initialization coefficients and then freeze them.
gradient_coordination.pcgrad: On shared encoder/fusion parameters, traverse loss groups in the listed fixed order and deterministically project a gradient against every earlier conflicting group when dot(g_i,g_j)<0. No random permutation. Private-only parameters retain their ordinary IGE-weighted gradients.
gradient_coordination.minnorm: Solve the non-negative minimum-norm convex combination of the three shared-parameter gradients every step; weights sum to the sum of active N00 IGE coefficients. Private-only parameters retain ordinary IGE-weighted gradients.

barlow_alignment.definition: Project the two modality embeddings to the same dimension; standardize each projected dimension across spots; C = Z1^T Z2 / n; loss is squared diagonal error plus (1/d) times squared off-diagonal entries.
barlow_alignment.weight_rule: At initialization set lambda so its shared-parameter gradient norm is 0.10 times the median IGE-weighted legacy loss gradient norm, cap lambda at 0.25, then freeze it.
barlow_alignment.forbidden: No label, seed, dataset-name, ARI, NMI, or downstream clustering input to the weight rule.

neighbor_alignment.definition: Symmetric cross-modal InfoNCE. Each spot's other-modality embedding is a positive; one deterministic M_shared neighbor, if present, is an additional positive. All other spots are negatives, evaluated exactly or in deterministic barcode-ordered chunks.
neighbor_alignment.weight_rule: Use the same 0.10 initial-gradient target and 0.25 cap as barlow_alignment, then freeze.
neighbor_alignment.forbidden: No pseudo-label, ground-truth label, stochastic negative mining, or seed-dependent sampling.

staging.definition: For staged candidates, train the first 25% of fixed epochs without the new alignment loss, then enable it at its frozen initialization-calibrated weight; total epochs and optimizer steps remain identical to N00.

candidates.purpose: Conservative unsupported-edge downweighting and graph-family dose response.

candidates.name: DETERMINISTIC_PCGRAD
candidates.purpose: Resolve training-time gradient conflicts that initialization-only IGE cannot address.

candidates.name: MINNORM_GRADIENT_BALANCE

candidates.purpose: Avoid early alignment collapse while retaining the same fixed training budget.

selection_constraints.round1_family_rescue: Retain the best positive, spatially valid member of graph, optimization, and alignment families before filling remaining slots by the locked score.
selection_constraints.combination_interpretability: N14 or N15 cannot be the sole promoted candidate unless at least one of N02/N03, N05, or N07/N09 shows non-negative evidence in the same round.
